facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT held a National Data Governance Policy Validation Workshop at Ezulwini on the draft National Data Governance Policy (2027-2031), bringing together government ministries, regulators, the private sector, civil society, academia and development partners; the document gives no workshop date, so the published date 2026-07-22 is used.
